hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Middle East, bordering the Gulf of Oman, the Persian Gulf, and the Caspian Sea, between Iraq and Pakistan || rugged, mountainous rim; high, central basin with deserts, mountains; small, discontinuous plains along both coasts || strategic location on the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, coal, chromium, copper, iron ore, lead, manganese, zinc, sulfur || Exports: plastics, iron ore, alcohols, natural gas, refined copper (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: rugged, mountainous rim; high, central basin with deserts, mountains; small, discontinuous plains along both coasts || Middle East, bordering the Gulf of Oman, the Persian Gulf, and the Caspian Sea, between Iraq and Pakistan

climate.excerpt: mostly arid or semiarid, subtropical along Caspian coast || periodic droughts, floods; dust storms, sandstorms; earthquakes

economy.excerpt: traditionally state-controlled economy but reforming state-owned financial entities; strong oil/gas, agricultural, and service sectors; recent massive inflation due to exchange rate depreciation, international sanctions, and investor uncertainty; increasing poverty || Exports: plastics, iron ore, alcohols, natural gas, refined copper (2023) || Industries: petroleum, petrochemicals, gas, fertilizer, caustic soda, textiles, cement and other construction materials, food processing (particularly sugar refining and vegetable oil production), ferrous and nonferrous metal fabrication, armaments
